narrative_purpose: Close the chapter on the returning image: a whole trading caravan riding one layer of a moving atmosphere, at the sedate pace the drag equation allows.
subject: Four translucent Medusoid bells of varying size drifting in a loose line across the frame, each with woven gondolas slung beneath it and a small team of flattened ray-shaped tug animals on lines ahead.
